text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to hone their skills has begun.
To prepare for a fulfilling autumn,
the Umamusume push themselves to the limit—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Let's focus on resting as much as possible"... Wait, why?!
choice_data_list: I'm doing this with your health in mind.
It's because I'm thinking of your health.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos has a delicate constitution.
If we push her as hard as the other girls,
there's a risk her health could worsen even further.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "...I understand how you feel too, Trainer. But..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Please!
You've gotta put in some serious training!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I understand my own body properly now too.
I definitely won't push myself too hard!
choice_data_list: I'll put together a training plan that'll help you grow properly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her abilities are already more than high enough.
Even with a lighter workload, she can still
achieve good results in the Shuka Sho.
choice_data_list: We've got the Shion Stakes in between too, so don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That might be true, but...
I don't want it to just be a "maybe" that I'll grow properly!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...I want to get stronger.
Strong enough to guarantee a win at the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Both the Oka Sho and the Yushun Himba were way tougher than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "...On top of that, big sis had a crazy amazing rival named Gentildonna-san, right?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I might not fully understand
everything you're feeling, Big Sis, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I realized... that I was taking on
such a monumental challenge.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...For this final crown,
I don't want to have any regrets whatsoever."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I wanna show off my super cool side to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I want to grow much, much more!
So... please,
let me train my hardest!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We'll push harder than the original plan to spur explosive growth,
while keeping it within limits that won't put undue strain on her body.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Thank you, Trainy♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry for being
so selfish, okay?"
choice_data_list: If it's such a gentle kind of selfishness, you're more than welcome.
A sweet kind of selfishness like that is more than welcome!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe.
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with our sights set on the Shion Stakes...
and the Shuka Sho beyond it,
our heated summer training camp began—
